criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bespoke test met; 1, 3 and 6 strong; 8 generic road with no subject and uncountable posts at feed size; 9 empty sorter beside a wireframe phone; 2 flies low separation with a dark blob; 7 dead lower half; 4 monochrome room with a mannequin.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds; the peach of 1's collar, 5's pail and 7's cubes dilutes the accent; no tonal arc.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals trace. Looser: 'Four kinds of fly' against c23; 'Every trap keeps everything' broader than c7; 'Models from USDA's lab in Kerrville' rests on c19's title only.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and when are clear; no action today.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Turn at 4 and 5 is real; 6 a detour; 8 cuttable.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic; the one unit per count rack is familiar.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild 9 as the payoff of 3 and cut or reconceive 8.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Empty sorter beside a wireframe phone on a flat green band, no focal.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push in low on the planks so the sorter fills half the frame and the phone screen is modelled, held at the frame edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Generic road with uncountable posts and empty sky.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at post height, fence diagonal from the lower left so all 19 are large, type over the dark ground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flies are dark blobs on lavender with a dark wash behind the tray.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera in 25 percent, warm key and rim on each fly, contact shadow under the tray only.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Even cubes on a flat void, dead lower half.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tilt the tray off the bottom edge and set the lifted cube large and warm in the foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Monochrome blue room, mannequin, catch unreadable at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop to the front rows at macro and put gloved hands sorting under a warm lamp in the foreground.
